title: Rams don't have a timeline on Myles Garrett's return

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams don't have a timeline on Myles Garrett's return
sources.description: Despite a report that Rams defensive end Myles Garrett would miss about six weeks with his knee injury, head coach Sean McVay says the team isn't working on a timeline that specific.
